headline: Core & D2C business to lead the way

highlights: HMN delivered a strong quarter, with revenue and EBITDA growing 36.2% and 24.5% YoY, respectively, while gross margins contracted 520bps, driven by elevated input costs and changing mix from acquired businesses.
Hair & Scalp Care and Skincare performed well, growing 30% and 31%, respectively, while OTC witnessed soft growth led by international supply chain issues.
Revenue grew by 36.2% and LTL volumes grew by 26%: Revenues grew by 36.2% YoY to Rs10.9bn (PLe: Rs9.902bn).
Gross margins contracted by 520bps YoY to 65.8% (Ple: 67.5%).
valuation: Valuations remain comforting at 17.4x FY29E EPS, however, sustained execution remains key to driving further upside.
